about.title: Our Story
about.text: Founded in 1979 by Chief Professor Benedict Onochie — the Ononenyi of Onitsha — Ado Palm Winery pioneered bottling the rich, sweet, earthy flavor of naturally fermented palm sap. Now led by third-generation Managing Director Francis N. Onochie and headquartered in Liberia, Costa Rica, we bring Vino de Coyol — a natural, probiotic national heritage of Costa Rica — to beach venues and homes worldwide.
about.qualityText: Family-led since 1979 — from Onitsha, Nigeria to our Pacific Coast headquarters in Liberia, Costa Rica.
about.sustainableText: Vino de Coyol is an all-natural, probiotic beverage crafted from fermented palm sap — a national heritage of Costa Rica.
about.worldwide: From Costa Rica to the World
about.worldwideText: Bringing our sunset to beach venues across the globe — from Ibiza and Phuket to Ipanema Beach.
